messages:
Marta: Heads-up: I'm reworking the Create Pool form today. Need quick alignment on three things: 1) when inline errors should appear (immediate on blur vs after submit), 2) how to mark required fields in dense lists, 3) delete confirmation pattern for pools with data.

Devon: For short forms like this, I prefer instant format validation on blur (email/number formats). But required-field badges after first submit to avoid noise.

Aisha: Accessibility checklist: never rely on color alone, use text + aria attributes. If we use an asterisk, include offscreen "required" text and set `aria-required=true`. Also make errors focusable via `aria-describedby`.

Sam: Delete UX: typed confirm only for pools that have >0 deployments or are tagged prod. For empty or staging pools use a modal + checkbox and show undo toast. Always show resource impact (machines, active models).

Lee: Implementation note: on submit failure, move keyboard focus to first invalid and announce via SR region: "Submission failed, moved to first error". Errors should use `role=alert` when inserted.

Marta: Quick copy draft for typed confirm modal: 

"Permanently delete pool 'hash-2024'? This action cannot be undone. Type the pool name to confirm: 
`hash-2024`"

Devon: small visual: render the typed token in monospace and faint background. Also include a short line showing "Active deployments: 2".

Aisha: If typed input mismatch, announce "Pool name does not match" and don't clear the user's input. Provide an inline inline error beneath the field.

Sam: UX rule suggestion: validation timing = blur for format, after-first-submit for missing/required. This is consistent and reduces flashiness.

Marta: Action items I'm capturing: 1) spec: format checks on blur, required errors after first submit, 2) required marker: prefer visible "Required" label in dense forms, asterisk + offscreen text otherwise, 3) delete flow: checkbox for low-risk, typed confirm for prod/non-empty with resource summary, 4) dev: implement aria-describedby linking, role=alert for errors, focus-first-invalid util, modal aria-live announcements.

design-bot: Summary generated and added to the Create Pool spec doc at docs/design/create-pool.md (draft).

Devon: I'll mock the modal and push screenshots.

Aisha: +1 on tests for SR + keyboard navigation.

Marta: Thanks all, I'll open the PR with copy + accessibility snippets later today and tag reviewers.
